title: King Tut: The Part Nobody Can Explain
description:
At Abydos, seventy-six kings are carved along one wall of the temple of Seti the First. Where the list reaches the Eighteenth Dynasty it steps from Amenhotep the Third straight to Horemheb, with nothing in between. Five rulers were taken out of that record, and one of them is the most famous Egyptian who ever lived. The men who opened his tomb were studied as a cohort; the result came back at nought point nine five.

59 freely licensed images and clips, each credited with its author and licence: https://toolbeltios.github.io/wak3upsociety-credits/king-tut.html
